title: Fig and the Pond
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 2 — Phase 4: CCVC words: two consonant sounds together at the start (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4, 73-sound stage (nd, nt, nk just added).

pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar sitting on a leaf at the edge of a round pond.

pages.text: Fig wants the flowers on the bank.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar looking across the pond at bright flowers on the far bank.

pages.text: Fig can not swim across the pond.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar looking down worriedly at the water, shaking his head.

pages.text: Fig went along the bank, not in the pond.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar crawling along the grassy edge, going around the pond.

pages.text: Fig creeps on the damp sand.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar crawling over a patch of damp sand by the water.

pages.text: A gust of wind picks up.
pages.illustration: Leaves and grass blowing sideways in a sudden gust of wind near the pond.

pages.text: Fig did not stop for the wind.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar gripping tight to a stem, pressing on despite the wind.

pages.text: Fig gets to the flowers at last.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar arriving at last among the bright flowers on the far bank.

pages.text: Fig naps in the sun with the flowers.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar curled up asleep in warm sunshine among the flowers.
